description: A three-row × three-column composite of OIM-EBSD maps of Fe-Mn-Al-C-(Ni) low-density steels in the HR+CR (hot-rolled + cold-rolled) condition, with ND drawn vertically and RD horizontally at the top-left corner. The rows are the alloys, labelled exactly as printed on the left: 28Mn0Ni (a–c), 28Mn5Ni (d–f) and 15Mn5Ni (g–i). The columns are: coloured inverse pole figure (IPF) maps for the austenite phase (a, d, g), greyscale image quality (IQ) maps (b, e, h) and phase contrast maps (c, f, i). (a) shows equiaxed austenite grains with a standard IPF colour triangle inset labelled 100, 110, 111. (b) is the IQ map in which parallel planar slip bands are visible, one marked with a blue arrow. (c) is uniformly red, i.e. single-phase FCC. (e) carries the only printed scale bar, 20 µm. (f) is almost entirely red with sparse blue B2 particles, and holds the legend (blue = B2, red = FCC). (g) shows a strongly banded IPF map plus an inset showing the IPF map of the B2 phase alone (black background, elongated stringer, yellow arrows marking shearing and fragmentation). (h) is an IQ map with dark vertical stringers; (i) shows numerous elongated blue B2 stringers in a red FCC matrix. Together the columns establish that phase fraction of B2 rises from zero (28Mn0Ni) through minor (28Mn5Ni) to abundant elongated stringers (15Mn5Ni), while austenite deforms everywhere by planar slip.
measured_quantities: phase fraction of B2 vs FCC (from phase contrast maps, qualitative)
crystallographic orientation / IPF colouring referenced to 100, 110, 111

observations.observation: The figure is a 3×3 EBSD composite: rows are the alloys 28Mn0Ni (a–c), 28Mn5Ni (d–f) and 15Mn5Ni (g–i), columns are IPF maps, IQ maps and phase contrast maps respectively, all in HR+CR condition.
The phase map (c) of 28Mn0Ni is uniformly red with no blue pixels, consistent with the caption/citing statement that 28Mn0Ni is single-phase austenite.
The phase map (f) of 28Mn5Ni is predominantly red FCC with only sparse, small blue B2 particles.
The phase map (i) of 15Mn5Ni contains numerous elongated blue B2 stringers aligned roughly parallel to the ND direction within a red FCC matrix.
The legend printed in panel (f) defines blue as B2 and red as FCC.
Panel (b) shows parallel intra-granular slip bands in 28Mn0Ni, one of them indicated by a blue arrow.
The inset of panel (g) shows the OIM-IPF map of the B2 phase alone (black background) with a single elongated stringer marked by yellow arrows indicating shearing and fragmentation.
A 20 µm scale bar is printed in panel (e) and applies to the EBSD maps of the group.
The IPF colour triangle inset in (a) is labelled 100, 110 and 111 for the austenite phase.
Both 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni exhibit a two-phase (γ + B2) microstructure in HR+CR condition, with a higher B2 fraction in 15Mn5Ni.
Irrespective of alloy content the austenite grains deformed mostly by planar slip, with no traces of deformation twinning or martensite transformation in any of the cold-rolled alloys.
Cold rolling reduced the average thickness of the B2 stringer from ~8 µm to ~2 µm, and the stringers eventually sheared and fragmented at higher strain.
A typical near-<100> oriented stringer undergoes shearing and subsequent fragmentation at ~35–45° to the rolling direction at two locations marked by arrows in the Fig. 1g inset.
The top-left of the figure gives the ND (vertical) and RD (horizontal) reference directions and the condition label HR+CR.

subfigures.description: Coloured IPF map for austenite of 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR condition: equiaxed, randomly oriented (multi-coloured) grains with a standard IPF colour triangle inset labelled 100, 110 and 111.
Image quality (IQ) map of 28Mn0Ni, greyscale; intra-granular parallel planar slip bands are visible and one band is marked by a blue arrow.
Phase contrast map of 28Mn0Ni, uniformly red throughout, showing no second phase resolvable above the map resolution.
Coloured IPF map for austenite of 28Mn5Ni; mixed multi-coloured grains with evidence of banding/elongation.
IQ map of 28Mn5Ni, greyscale, with wavy deformation substructure; carries the figure's printed 20 µm scale bar.
Phase contrast map of 28Mn5Ni, dominated by red FCC with sparse small blue B2 particles; contains the legend blue = B2, red = FCC.

Coloured IPF map for austenite of 15Mn5Ni showing elongated, banded grains aligned with the ND direction; an inset shows the IPF map of the B2 phase alone (black background, one elongated bright stringer) with yellow arrows marking shearing and fragmentation at two locations.
IQ map of 15Mn5Ni, greyscale, with pronounced dark vertical bands (B2 stringers) running through the mapped area.
Phase contrast map of 15Mn5Ni, red FCC matrix traversed by numerous thick, elongated blue B2 stringers oriented roughly parallel to ND.
